title: Choose the new Storyline world
question: A fresh light-mode visual system for developers understanding an unfamiliar codebase.

options.label: Approach Plate
options.lineage: aviation navigation charts and approach plates
options.thesis: A codebase becomes a navigable route: clear bearings, a primary path, and detail only when it helps the developer orient.
options.viewport: A tall route strip anchors the center; a compact flight-plan index sits left, and the selected behavior opens as a clear information plate on the right.
options.risk: Must stay humane and calm, never become faux-military instrumentation.

options.label: One-bit Desktop
options.thesis: Exploration happens through crisp overlapping windows and direct manipulation.
options.viewport: A light desktop holds a story window, an evidence window, and a compact codebase index.
options.risk: Memorable and direct, but its nostalgia could distract from calm comprehension.
options.case: Strong developer recognition; weaker fit with the requested friendly light-mode calm.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: Stories become a prioritized board whose meaningful changes update in a visible rhythm.
options.viewport: A large flow board lists story steps as mechanical rows, with one focused route expanded beneath.
options.risk: Makes sequence exceptionally clear, but can feel too operational for open-ended investigation.
options.case: Strong product clarity; loses some audience warmth by framing exploration as dispatch.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: A codebase is opened in layers, each cut revealing a more specific space to explore.
options.viewport: Stacked pale structural blocks form the flow, with carved openings revealing behaviors and evidence.
options.risk: Beautifully distinctive, but risks turning a working tool into an illustration.
options.case: Audience identification is weaker than the proposed route metaphor; it fuses poorly with rapid scanning.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A restrained light dashboard, executed with exceptional clarity.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional app shell with flow cards, a details sidebar, and searchable navigation.
canonCard.risk: Safest and clearest, but least distinctive.
